name: Scarred Gem - Jeonglyeongseog-ui Guae
source: Due to an unforeseen accident, our protagonist ruins his university entrance exams. As our protagonist makes up his mind to re-take the entrance exams, a mysterious girl appears and hands him a broken pendant while speaking in an unknown language. Although suspicious, he brings the pendant home with him. This awakens the spirit in the pendant and with her support, our protagonist has to find his significant other. (...  what happened to re-taking the entrance exams?)
translation: 一场意外令主人公的大学入学考试彻底失败。他下定决心重新备考时，一名神秘少女突然出现，一边说着听不懂的语言，一边递给他一枚破损的吊坠。尽管心存疑虑，他还是把吊坠带回了家。这唤醒了寄宿其中的精灵；在她的帮助下，主人公必须找到自己的命定之人。（……重新参加大学入学考试的事呢？）
